thread:
Asha: Quick heads-up 94 Prospect: Helios Health (opp HL-0923). Security team wants our SOC 2 Type II to unblock procurement. POC is Wed. They explicitly said they won't sign our full NDA yet. Any alternatives to handing over the PDF?

Tom: We usually avoid sending full reports without NDA. Options I can think of: secure viewer (DocSend-like ephemeral link), time-limited presigned S3, or a curated one-page controls summary + signed attestation.

Renee: We have an internal "secure viewer" workflow where we upload to our gated doc portal (read-only, copy/paste disabled) and issue a link that requires email verification. That buys us audit logs and no-file-drop. Faster than Legal getting involved.

Asha: Does ops support that with the right logs? Helios wants to show the report to 3 internal reviewers.

ops-bot: Portal workflow supported. Requirements: recipient emails, max 5 viewers, link expiry <= 96h, and viewer must pass 2FA (email token). Access logged to Evidence Tracker. Ticket OPS-4999 created. ETA 6 hours to provision.

Tom: 96h is a bit long; our policy recommends <=72h. Can we do 72h and allow up to 3 viewers?

ops-bot: Adjusted: 72h expiry, max 3 viewers, 2FA enforced. Update applied to OPS-4999.

Renee: Legal check: can we use the portal without an acknowledgement? I'd prefer a short click-through TOS that says "received under limited use for vendor risk review". legal-bot: Interim access clause available; Legal advises a click-through attestation.

legal-bot: Recommended text (one liner): "By accessing this document you agree to treat it as confidential and use it solely for vendor security review for Helios Health; you must not redistribute." Use email thread capture as minimal record.

Asha: Great. Can someone paste the portal link and the short attestation to pass to the customer? Helios SOW expects the doc before kickoff.

Tom: I'll coordinate with ops. Also note: if they insist on a downloadable copy we fallback to presigned S3 with strict IP allowlist and our interim-attestation. Presign command (ops internal):
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-soc2-temp/helios-soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 259200 --region us-west-2
```
But prefer portal first.

Renee: Also worth offering a "controls snapshot" PDF: 4 pages covering scope, auditor, control categories, and SOC 2 opinion. That's what many buyers accept for initial risk triage. We can generate that in <24h.

Asha: Proposed sequence to Helios: 1) Portal secure-view link + click-through attestation (today) 2) If they need download, provide redacted presigned S3 with signed acknowledgement (next day) 3) If they demand full unredacted, escalate to Legal for NDA/bridge-letter.

Tom: Sounds good. Asha, get me the reviewer emails and I'll kick OPS-4999.

Asha: Sent: vendorsec@helioshealth.com, security-lead@helioshealth.com, procurement@helioshealth.com

ops-bot: OPS-4999 updated: Portal link created, expiry 72h, viewers whitelisted: vendorsec@helioshealth.com, security-lead@helioshealth.com, procurement@helioshealth.com. Access method: email token + click-through attestation. Link dispatched to vendorsec@helioshealth.com. Audit log will be attached to Evidence Tracker entry HELIOS-HL-0923.

Renee: I'll prep the 4-page controls snapshot as a backup and attach it to the Evidence Tracker.

Asha: Thanks team. If Helios responds asking for a "bridge letter" template, note: Legal requires signed statement from the customer accepting responsibility for controlling the copy and agreeing not to redistribute. That typically takes 1 business day.

Tom: Please keep procurement looped. Asha, forward this thread to the deal owner and mark the record in SFDC.

Asha: Will do. Closing here once they confirm access/download.

ops-bot: OPS-4999 closed: portal link accessed by security-lead@helioshealth.com. Evidence Tracker updated.
